name: reactemail
description: Load, edit and save email templates with the React Email 6 editor, as a Mendix pluggable widget.
author: João Lopes
comment_react_version: Both the toolchain major and React must match the target Studio Pro.
This widget targets Mendix 11.12 with the React client, which ships React 19.2.3,
so it builds with pluggable-widgets-tools 11.12.x and pins react and react-dom to 19.2.3.
For a Mendix 10.24 app use pluggable-widgets-tools 10.24.0 and React 18.2.0 instead.
react and react-dom must NOT be listed as dependencies: the toolchain treats them
as provided by the client and prompts to migrate if it finds them. Pin them
React must match the version the Mendix client provides, exactly. The client
supplies react and react-dom at runtime, but react-dom/server is not on that
externals list, so React Email's HTML renderer is bundled into the widget and
reads internals off the host's React, which are renamed between majors.
A React 18 build on a React 19 client fails at page load with: Cannot read
the app's Mendix version changes its React version.
